name: cl_440V_stepdown
description: 25 -> 12.5 A load step at 14 ms at Vin 440 V (highest inner-loop gain). Closed loop, comparator PWM on a 25 ns solver grid (PWM resolution 0.5 V at the output). The campaign driver (results/run_campaign.py) replaces the module single-loop PI by the cascaded average-current-mode controller of models/campaign_manifest.json; the pi block here is the module fallback and is used only by the run whose manifest controller is 'module'. Sources: design/design_decisions.json (schema 3, 2026-10-10) with design/research/{mosfet,capacitors,inductor,gate_driver}.json after their verify_*.json corrections; task-provided values are labelled in simulation_report.md
